description: Factory guardrails. They only activate in repos that have .factory/product.json. PreToolUse(Bash) denies destructive or out-of-policy commands (pushing to protected branches, force-push, merging PRs, piping downloads into a shell) and asks before deploys, store submits and publishes. PreToolUse(Write|Edit|NotebookEdit) blocks edits to secrets and to factory-managed files. Stop runs the product's onStop gates (e.g. lint, typecheck) when files changed, and gives up after 2 consecutive blocks.
